findings.evidence: GraphStep.lean:195-288 vs W2p.lean:98-212 and W3p.lean:96-235; grep for `WeakDerivStep` outside GraphStep.lean matches only lines 64 of W2p.lean and W3p.lean.
findings.fix: Make the order-specific names specialize the step: `def W2p.hessianL := WeakDerivStep.derivL W1p.gradientL`, `W3p.thirdDerivativeL := WeakDerivStep.derivL W2p.hessianL`, likewise for `firstOrderL`/`secondOrderL`, `mk`, `hasWeakFDerivOn_*`, and the `norm_*`/`norm_sq_*` lemmas, deleting the duplicated proofs and the redundant `CompleteSpace` instances in W2p.lean:211 and W3p.lean:234. If the generic surface is not meant to be used yet, delete the `WeakDerivStep` namespace instead and keep only `weakDerivStepSubmodule` plus the two `mem_*` lemmas that W2p/W3p actually consume.
findings.issue: The whole `WeakDerivStep` namespace is a duplicate of the W2p/W3p surfaces and has no consumer: `grep -rn WeakDerivStep TauCeti/` outside GraphStep.lean matches only `W2p.lean:64` and `W3p.lean:64`, both for `WeakDerivStepJetLp`. Since `w2pSubmodule := weakDerivStepSubmodule mu Omega p W1p.gradientL` (W2p.lean:70) and `W2p`/`WeakDerivStep` are both `abbrev`s for `(·).toSubmodule`, the pairs `prevL`/`W2p.firstOrderL` (identical bodies), `derivL`/`W2p.hessianL`, `prev`/`W2p.firstOrder`, `deriv`/`W2p.hessian`, `mk`/`W2p.mk`, `prev_mk`/`W2p.firstOrder_mk`, `deriv_mk`/`W2p.hessian_mk`, `hasWeakFDerivOn_prev`/`W2p.hasWeakFDerivOn_gradient`, `norm_prev_le`/`W2p.norm_firstOrder_le`, `norm_deriv_le`/`W2p.norm_hessian_le`, `norm_sq_eq_norm_prev_sq_add_norm_deriv_sq`/`W2p.norm_sq_eq_norm_firstOrder_sq_add_norm_hessian_sq`, and the `CompleteSpace` instances are two names for the same function/theorem — and the same duplication repeats verbatim against `W3p.secondOrder*`/`W3p.thirdDerivative*`/`W3p.mk`/`W3p.hasWeakFDerivOn_hessian`/`W3p.norm_*` in W3p.lean:96-217. A user holding `WeakDerivStep.deriv W1p.gradientL u` has no lemma relating it to `W2p.hessian u`.

findings.evidence: GraphStep.lean:192-290 contains no `ext` declaration; W3p.lean:157 `refine Subtype.ext ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ _ _).injective ?_)` duplicates W2p.lean:154.
findings.fix: Add `@[ext] theorem WeakDerivStep.ext (base) {u v} (hprev : prev base u = prev base v) (hderiv : deriv base u = deriv base v) : u = v` in GraphStep.lean and derive `W2p.ext_firstOrder` / `W3p.ext_secondOrder` from it instead of re-doing the `Subtype.ext`/`prodContinuousLinearEquiv` unfolding.
findings.issue: The shared step's characteristic API is incomplete: it has `mk`, `prev_mk`, `deriv_mk` but no extensionality lemma from agreement of `prev` and `deriv`, which is exactly the lemma both specializations need and therefore hand-roll by unfolding the representation through `WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv.injective` (W2p.lean:151-155, W3p.lean:154-162).

summary: The PR ships a general public `WeakDerivStep` projection/constructor/norm API and then, in the same PR, re-implements a defeq copy of it twice (W2p, W3p), so every step lemma exists under two unrelated names with no bridge. The shared step also lacks the extensionality lemma both specializations hand-roll.
